locations.name: The Bohemian Riviera

exterior.description: A cobblestone Gilded Square street narrows, dips, and opens directly onto a raked ribbon of imported sand laid over embankment concrete. The Bacchanus is visible the entire time, a slow murky river doing its level best to look like a coastline. No gate, no threshold — the sand simply starts, marked by a sun-faded 'THE BOHEMIAN RIVIERA' signpost with a delivery manifest number zip-tied underneath. A sagging vinyl banner over the catapult reads 'BEATDOWN — LETO — SEZONA 22.' Eurodance bleeds from three unsynced bar sound systems, an EMTV crane camera occasionally swings into frame, and gulls that are almost certainly pigeons work the sand.
exterior.entry_condition: Accessible anytime, 24/7. Entering fauxst_beach on any active filming day auto-triggers the Beatdown sign-up sequence.

interior.theme: A landlocked country's beach resort built entirely out of confidence and trucked-in sand, hosting a reality-TV catapult show

functions: Quest hub for debaucheryville_sidequest_bacchanus_beach_beatdown_01 (the Bacchanus Beach Beatdown catapult-trivia show)
Bar-hop / social district — three named beach bars (Za Za Beach Klub, The Tan Line, Kokos Loco)
port_o_cologne status acquisition (any launch) and cure loop (Zdenka's riverbank cart)
Night-party unlock as a future-questline seed (hook only)

quest_npc_petra_production_assistant.description: Runs sign-up, full disclosure, and release-form collection at signup_table. Auto-triggers on entry to fauxst_beach during an active filming day.
quest_npc_petra_production_assistant.mechanics: Gates entry into Bro Select and the trivia gauntlet; discloses every material fact before any form is signed.

quest_npc_jaxson_vane.description: Hosts the trivia gauntlet and Sudden Death at catapult_row and prize_podium.
quest_npc_jaxson_vane.mechanics: Tracks the selected bro's visible strike counter, pulls the lever on any third strike or disqualification, announces the outcome.

quest_npc_janek_sykora.description: Contestant Four; the quest's only genuine skill gate at catapult_row / prize_podium.
quest_npc_janek_sykora.mechanics: Cannot be struck out; the Sudden Death 1.5-second buzzer window is the sole win condition against him.

quest_npc_hamstradamus_beach_variant.description: Filming-day-only appearance at prize_podium; secondary location, primary residence is the Cirque du Shady prophecy tent.
quest_npc_hamstradamus_beach_variant.mechanics: Delivers the canon-locked WIN prophecy and pins item_trivia_champ_badge; absent from the LOSS branch entirely.

mini_game_minigame_beatdown_trivia_gaunt.description: Nine-question round-robin trivia gauntlet at catapult_row, 4 concurrent contestants, 3 strikes, 12-second timer per question.
mini_game_minigame_beatdown_trivia_gaunt.mechanics: Non-selected bros hard-strikeout at Q4 and Q7 (mid-sentence); Janek's scripted thrown answer at ~Q6; the selected bro's confidently-wrong shout is always one of the four selectable options.

mini_game_minigame_beatdown_sudden_death.description: Head-to-head buzzer duel vs. Janek Sýkora at prize_podium, triggered on <=2 strikes after Q9.
mini_game_minigame_beatdown_sudden_death.mechanics: Win condition: buzz inside Janek's 1.5-second crew-team wave window and answer correctly; audio-only tell (oar catch-and-release).

event_hook_beatdown_launch_sequence.description: Three independently-triggerable catapult launch units at catapult_row.
event_hook_beatdown_launch_sequence.mechanics: Fires on third strike, hard-timed non-selected-bro strikeouts (Q4/Q7), or a Sudden Death loss; arc must clear the inflatable palms and lifeguard tower before splash impact.

selfie_prop_catapult_row.description: Three port-o-potties on the pneumatic arm, inflatable palms, space heaters, lifeguard tower, and EMTV crane in one establishing frame.
selfie_prop_catapult_row.mechanics: High social-media viral potential screenshot moment; available any time catapult_row is visible, filming day or not.

npc_group_college_vacationers.description: 8-12 ambient college-age vacationers, density highest at bar_strip and fauxst_beach.
npc_group_college_vacationers.mechanics: Sign-up witnesses, Beatdown spectators, and heckle-line deliverers on the LOSS-branch walk of shame; Czech-parody heckle/mistranslation pairs.

shop_node_beach_bar.description: Three named beach bars along bar_strip: Za Za Beach Klub, The Tan Line, Kokos Loco.
shop_node_beach_bar.mechanics: Sells beach-bar consumables including item_kokos_loco_bucket and item_tan_line_neon_shooter; landlocked beach-resort pricing (river-embankment rates charged at Mediterranean prices).

hidden_area_night_party_zone.description: Locked until the Beatdown resolves (WIN, LOSS, or DISQUALIFICATION) at least once.
hidden_area_night_party_zone.mechanics: String lights, migrating sound system, ambient-only content — seed for a future questline (working name 'Herp'); no new mechanics, NPCs, or narrative beats beyond ambient dressing are authored here.

examinable_no_diving_sign.description: Hand-lettered 'NO DIVING (SERIOUSLY, IT'S 40cm)' sign zip-tied to the lifeguard tower ladder at fauxst_beach.
examinable_no_diving_sign.mechanics: 40cm vs. 60cm depth discrepancy with Standa's own admission is intentional, not a bug to reconcile.

examinable_release_form.description: Four-page, single-spaced Czech-parody legalese release form at signup_table.
examinable_release_form.mechanics: Read-aloud offer always available from Petra, never accepted by the bros.

examinable_port_o_potty_center_broken_la.description: The center port-o-potty's door latch is visibly broken and swings open under its own weight, at catapult_row.
examinable_port_o_potty_center_broken_la.mechanics: Purely visible before sign-in; reusable idle-open animation state outside the launch sequence.
